descriptionChirho: A place set apart as sacred, especially the tabernacle or temple dedicated to the worship of God; used in both singular absolute and construct forms with various possessive suffixes and prepositions.
Plural form referring to multiple sacred sites, sanctuary precincts, or holy places, sometimes the various parts of the temple complex or multiple places of worship including illegitimate ones.
A holy or consecrated portion or thing, referring not to a place but to something set apart as sacred, such as a dedicated offering or sacred allotment.
